title: TheBackroooms
description: Transforms Minecraft with Backrooms-inspired block textures for a mysterious and eerie atmosphere.
body:
# TheBackrooms

TheBackrooms is a resource pack that replaces various block textures with Backrooms-inspired designs, giving your world the iconic yellow walls, old carpets, and unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms. Perfect for horror maps, exploration, and immersive Backrooms-themed gameplay.
